chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Jakob in a khualzinna zom a, nisuahna lam mite’ gam tung hi.
A khuadak leh gam lakah tuikhuk khat mu hi, en in, tua gei-ah tuuhon thum lum hi; bang hang hiam cih leh tua tuikhuk panin tuuhonte tui kipia hi. Tuikhuk gong-a suang lian hi,
tua lai munah tuuhonte khempeuh a kikaihkhop khit ciangin, tuucingte in tuikhuk kong panin suang khukkhia uh a, tuute tui pia-in, tuikhuk kong ama' omna ngei-ah suang koih kik uh hi.
Jakob in amaute' kiangah, “Sanggamte aw, koi pan-a hong pai na hi uh hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Haran pan hi ung,” ci hi.
Amah in amaute' kiangah, “Nahor’ tapa Laban na thei uh hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Thei mah ung,” ci hi.
Amah in amaute' kiangah, “Amah a cidam hiam?” ci hi. Amaute in, “Dam hi; en in, a tanu Rachael zong tuu tawh hong pai!” ci uh hi.
Amah in, “En un, ni sang lai hi, gan kaihkhop hun hi lo hi; tuute tui pia un la, pai-in an nesak un,” ci hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in, “Tuute kikaikhawm a, tuikhuk gong panin suang a kikhuk mateng ka hih thei kei uh hi; tua ciangin tuute tui ka pia thei pan uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Amah in amaute tawh a kiho lai takin a pa’ tuute tawh Rachel hong tung hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in tuate kem hi.
Tu-in Jakob in a nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tanu Rachel leh a nu' sanggampa Laban’ tuute a muh ciangin, Jakob paito-in tuikhuk gong panin suang khukkhia a, a nu’ sanggampa Laban’ tuuhonte tui pia hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in Rachel nam a, a gingin kapkhia hi.
Jakob in Rachel’ kiangah amah in a pa’ behte hi a, amah in Rebekah’ tapa a hihna kigen hi; tua ciangin Rachel tai-in a pa’ kiangah gen hi.
Laban in a sanggamnu’ tapa Jakob’ thu a zak ciangin amah dawn dingin hong tai a, amah kawi-in nam a, a innah ciahpih hi. Jakob in Laban’ tungah hih thute khempeuh gen a,
Laban in ama' kiangah, “Nang in keima si keima sa na hi takpi hi,” ci hi. Tua hi a, amah tawh kha khat om hi.
Tua ciangin Laban in Jakob kiangah, “Nang in keimah' beh na hih ciangin, man nei lopi-in kei’ na hong sem ding na hi hiam? Hong gen in, na thaman ding bang hi ding hiam?” a ci hi.
Tu-in Laban in tanu nih nei hi; a u-zaw min Leah hi a, a nauzaw’ min Rachel ahi hi.
Leah’ mit-hah neem a, ahih hangin Rachel mel hoih-in deihhuai hi.
Jakob in Rachel ngai hi; amah in, “Na tanu a nauzaw Rachel thalawh nadingin nangma' na kum sagih kong sem ding hi,” ci hi.
Laban in, “Mi dang' tungah amah ka piak ding sangin nang' tungah amah kong piak ding hoih zaw hi; kei tawh om in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Jakob in Rachel ngah nadingin kum sagih na sem a, amah a itna hangin tua hunte ni tawmno khat tawh kibang sa hi.
Tua ciangin Jakob in Laban' kiangah, “Ka hun cingta ahih ciangin amah tawh ka lupkhawm theih nadingin ka zi hong pia in,” ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Laban in tua mun-a mi khempeuh kaikhawmin pawi khat bawl hi.
Ahih hangin a nitak ciangin amah in a tanu Leah la-in Jakob' kiangah paipih hi; amah in tua nu luppih hi.
(Laban in ama' numei-nasem Zilpah a tanu Leah tungah a numei-nasem dingin pia hi.)

A zingsang ciangin, en in, Leah na hi mawk hi; Jakob in Laban’ kiangah, “Kei' tungah bang hong bawl na hi hiam? Rachel ngah nadingin na na hong sem hilo ka hi hiam? Tua ahih leh bang hangin kei hong khem na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Laban in, “A u’ ma-in a nauzaw piak ding ko’ gamah kizang lo hi.
Hih nu’ adingin nipi khat sung pawi beisak phot in la, a dang kum sagih ka na nong sepsak thaman-in a khat pen zong kong pia ding uh hi,” ci hi.
Tua mah bangin Jakob gamta a, tua nu’ pawi hun sung beisak phot hi; tua ciangin Laban in a tanu Rachel a zi dingin pia hi.
(Laban in ama' numei-nasem Bilhah a tanu Rachel' tungah a numei-nasem dingin pia hi.)
Tua ahih ciangin Jakob in Rachel zong luppih a, amah in Leah sangin Rachel it zaw hi; Laban’ na a dang kum sagih sung sem hi.
Topa in Leah a kimuhdahna a theih ciangin, amah in a naubu hon’ sak hi; ahih hangin Rachel ciing hi.
Leah gai-in tapa khat nei a, amah in a min Reuben ci hi; bang hang hiam cih leh amah in, “ Topa in ka thuakna hong en zo hi; tu-in ka pasal in kei hong it taktak ding hi,” ci hi.
Amah gai kikin tapa khat nei a, amah in, “Keimah hong kimuhdahna thu Topa in za khin ahih manin, amah in hih tapa zong hong pia hi,” ci hi; amah in a min Simeon ci hi.
Amah gai leuleu-in tapa khat nei a, “Amah tawh tapa thum nei ta ka hih manin tu-in ka pasal in kei hong pawl ding hi,” ci hi; tua ahih ciangin ama' min Levi kici hi.
Amah gai leuleu-in tapa khat nei a, “Tu hunin Topa ka phat ding hi,” ci hi; tua ahih ciangin amah in a min Judah phuak hi; tua ciangin ta neih tawp hi.
